## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
waffle <- function(x, rows, cols = seq_along(x), ...) {
  xx <- rep(cols, times = x)
  lx <- length(xx)
  m <- matrix(nrow = rows, ncol = (lx %/% rows) + (lx %% rows != 0))
  m[1:length(xx)] <- xx

  op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(op))

  par(list(...))
  plot.new()
  o <- cbind(c(row(m)), c(col(m))) + 1
  plot.window(xlim = c(0, max(o[, 2]) + 1), ylim = c(0, max(o[, 1]) + 1),
              asp = 1, xaxs = 'i', yaxs = 'i')
  rect(o[, 2], o[, 1], o[, 2] + .85, o[, 1] + .85, col = c(m), border = NA)

  invisible(list(m = m, o = o))
}


cols <- c("lightgrey", "red", "#00BFC4", "#C77CFF")
m <- waffle(c(100, 0, 0, 0), rows = 10, cols = cols, mar = c(0,0,0,7),
            bg = 'white')
#legend('right', legend = LETTERS[1:2], pch = 15, col = cols, pt.cex = 2,
      # bty = 'n')
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
waffle <- function(x, rows, cols = seq_along(x), ...) {
  xx <- rep(cols, times = x)
  lx <- length(xx)
  m <- matrix(nrow = rows, ncol = (lx %/% rows) + (lx %% rows != 0))
  m[1:length(xx)] <- xx

  op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(op))

  par(list(...))
  plot.new()
  o <- cbind(c(row(m)), c(col(m))) + 1
  plot.window(xlim = c(0, max(o[, 2]) + 1), ylim = c(0, max(o[, 1]) + 1),
              asp = 1, xaxs = 'i', yaxs = 'i')
  rect(o[, 2], o[, 1], o[, 2] + .85, o[, 1] + .85, col = c(m), border = NA)

  invisible(list(m = m, o = o))
}


cols <- c("lightgrey", "red")
m <- waffle(c(100, 0), rows = 10, cols = cols, mar = c(0,0),
            bg = 'white')
legend('right', legend = LETTERS[1:2], pch = 15, col = cols, pt.cex = 2,
       bty = 'n')
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
